answer: In the EigenTrust-style matrix, reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so even a glacier of accumulated trust requires sustained honest service to remain influential. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity propagates only earned endorsements; freshly spawned nebula or juniper identities have negligible incoming trust and near-zero eigenvector centrality, preventing them from meeting consensus thresholds until they build a durable, corroborated history.
